subject: AWS Marketplace onboarding — SOW & cost split for listing and co-sell
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: AWS Marketplace onboarding — SOW & cost split for listing and co-sell

Quick context: AWS has approved us for the listing but legal/product need a clear SOW and a cost split for the listing fee + onboarding services. We also need to confirm whether the co-sell registration requires an additional listing fee (I thought no, but partner ops flagged a potential one-time Admin charge).

Asks: 
- Vanessa: can you review the attached SOW (v1.2) for scope and hourly rates? Highlight any items you think we should push into a fixed-fee scope.
- Marcus: please confirm how we'd prefer to amortize the listing fee across Q4/Q1 (capex vs. opex) and whether finance needs a PO template up front.
- Karthik: I need a one-paragraph customer-facing blurb about the co-sell benefits to include in the marketplace listing checklist.

Attachments: SOW_Redwood_AWS_v1.2.pdf (draft), AWS_fee_breakdown_Nov2026.xlsx (placeholder — requesting official numbers from AWS)

Desired timeline: SOW approved by 12/6 so we can send to Partner Ops and get final fee memo by week of 12/13.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-30T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace onboarding — SOW & cost split for listing and co-sell

Jordan — thanks for the summary. Quick read of the SOW: overall clean, a few notes inline (see PDF comments) but main items to discuss:

- Professional services hours: onboarding + catalog prep looks like 40–60 hrs. I recommend a fixed fee for catalog prep and an hourly retainer for integration support.
- Go-live acceptance criteria are a bit loose — suggest we add explicit checklist items (listing metadata, billing test, co-sell badge eligibility).
- I marked Legal-only items (IP assurances) that we should not pre-commit to in SOW; redirect to legal for contract-level language.

On the fee split: if AWS charges a one-time administrative/listing fee, I suggest we treat it as a sales/partner expense and split 50/50 between GTM and Partnerships for budgeting this fiscal year. Marcus — can you confirm this is OK from finance?

I'll prepare the one-paragraph co-sell blurb and send by EOD.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Jen Smith <jen.smith@aws-partner.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-partner-ops@amazon.com
Date: 2026-12-02T15:20:00Z
Subject: RE: AWS Marketplace onboarding — SOW & cost split for listing and co-sell

Hi Jordan / team — thanks for the heads up and the draft SOW. A couple of clarifications from Partner Ops and Marketplace Billing: 

1) Listing/admin fee: there is a one-time marketplace listing admin fee that varies by category. For our category (AI platforms) the current one-time fee is typically $6,500 and is invoiced to the seller. We can confirm exact charge once you submit the listing form.

2) Co-sell registration: there is no additional AWS Marketplace listing fee for co-sell registration itself, but co-sell enablement (solution validation & launch support) may require a separate enablement engagement with a cost we can discuss.

3) Required artifacts: final SOW, seller legal entity docs, and a product description for the catalog. Please also include an estimated monthly MRR projection to help marketplace prioritize the onboarding queue.

I've attached the fee guidance sheet we use internally — I can follow up with a formal invoice once the listing is approved.

Best — Jen
Jen Smith
Partner Programs, AWS Marketplace
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Jen Smith <jen.smith@aws-partner.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-12-05T16:47:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace onboarding — SOW & cost split for listing and co-sell

Jen — thanks, that helps a lot. We'll proceed on the following basis:

- Accept the $6,500 one-time listing admin fee (pending final confirmation) and treat it as a partner expense split 50/50 between GTM and Partnerships per Vanessa's recommendation. Marcus, please prepare a PO template for this and confirm cost center allocations.
- Vanessa will convert the SOW catalog-prep scope to a fixed fee and keep the integration/retainer hourly. New SOW attached (v1.3) with the changes highlighted.
- Karthik will provide the one-paragraph co-sell blurb and a conservative MRR projection by 12/8 so we can submit the listing form to Jen.

Next steps: Vanessa to finalize SOW (by 12/6) -> Jordan to upload listing + docs to AWS -> Jen to provide invoice and expected timeline for listing activation.

Attachments: SOW_Redwood_AWS_v1.2.pdf (updated comments applied; final will be v1.3 pending Vanessa)

Thanks everyone — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships (acting)
